need: a thing that must be true before a node can run. a node has needs.

a node needs some things true before it can run.
a node gives some things true after it runs.
an edge from the first node to the next node can run only when the first node gives all that the next node needs.
a path can run only when each edge in it can run.
the score of a path is for me to use only after the path can run. a path that can not run is not for me to choose, and the score of it is not for me to use.
so i can make a path that is not in the code: when one node gives what an other node needs, there is an edge from the first to the other, also when the two were never next in the code.
when i change one part of a path so a node no longer gives what the next node needs, that edge can not run. then the path can not run. i know why: i say the node, the need, and the give that is not there.
